 Yandy Diaz’s postseason steak eating gets the T-shirt treatment 
 Notes | What started during the Sept. 11 playoff-clinching celebration has spawned several new developments, now including a shirt.     .   Rays designated hitter Yandy Diaz wears a T-shirt Tuesday at Tropicana Field to commemorate his famous playoff-clinching snack, a tomahawk steak. “As you can tell," he said with a smile, "I look pretty good in it.” [ MARC TOPKIN | Times ] Marc Topkin is a sports reporter covering the Tampa Bay Rays. Reach him at mtopkin@tampabay.com.
